annotations.text:
The flow, left to right: connect, say what you want, find out whether tonight is even the night, get a plan whose every number shows its reasoning.

Below: the camera itself, a run in progress, and the same control screen in red for 2am.

Three control states, visible in artboard 5:

Solid border — the app can set it.
Dashed grey — a dial owns it, and it says which.
Dashed amber — writable in principle, inert right now, with the reason.

The blue strip above them is the camera reporting a change someone made by hand.
